The `plugin_market` tool reads this same index."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Other way | Command | Use it when |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| CLI | `dsh plugin --profile <name> add 'git+https://github.com/Natsubrei/dsh-comfyui-panel.git#<co"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"mmit>'` | You copy `<commit>` from the market card. An unpinned URL follows the default branch, whic"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"h can be ahead of that release. |
| npm | `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-comfyui-panel` | The "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"version does not matter. npm does not carry every indexed release. |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Restart DSH if it was already running. Hard-refresh the browser after a bundle change."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. Click **ComfyUI** in the left sidebar. The editor fills the main column. An assistant sits on the"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" right.
2. The column on the right sends into that page's session. The model then uses the tools in "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"the table below on the open canvas.
3. Leave the server at `http://127.0.0.1:8188`, or set another a"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ddress under Configuration.
4. If nothing is running, open the chip at the bottom-left of the canvas"},{"id":"p15s5","text":". **Server settings** is where the folder that contains `main.py` is chosen; **Start** is on the chi"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"p. A common location is detected. **Start with DSH** is remembered. A server that is already running"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" is adopted, not started twice.
5. Wait until the chip says **Running**. Ask in the right column. Th"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"e model uses this page's tools, including a run. A tool that needs the editor fails when you leave t"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"he page. **New** starts another session for this page; the previous one keeps its history. Collapsin"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"g the column leaves a tab on the right edge that opens it again."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"No ComfyUI yet: `node test/mock-comfyui.mjs`, open **ComfyUI** in the sidebar, and wait until the ch"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ip says **Running**. The mock is a one-node graph, and `comfyui_run` returns `p1`. Stop the mock bef"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ore a real ComfyUI uses port 8188."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Contributors run `npm test` and `npm run typecheck`. What those cover is in CONTRIBUTING.md."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Capabilities"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Tools exist only on a session that has synced a workflow. After a Host restart, a persisted session "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"gets them back. A new session gets them on its first sync."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Open** in the Panel column means the panel has to be open in that session. **No** means it can be "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"* in the Panel column means the panel has to be open in that session. **No** means it can be closed."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Panel"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Capability | What you get |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Editor | The real ComfyUI frontend at `/comfyui/`, over authenticated HTTP and WebSocket. The same"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"-origin iframe keeps third-party node UIs. It does not use DSH theme tokens. A custom node UI runs a"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"s the DSH page. See SECURITY.md. |
| Bridge | Once `window.comfyAPI.app.app` exists, the panel syncs"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" about once a second while the page is open. It sends the UI workflow, a read-only projection, and t"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"he API prompt from `graphToPrompt()`. The UI workflow is canonical. Editor events (`execution_start`"},{"id":"p23s6","text":", `executing`, `progress`, `executed`, success, error, interrupted, and queue status) are relayed on"},{"id":"p23s7","text":" the editor's own socket. That socket is the one a run is addressed to. The panel does not open a se"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"cond ComfyUI socket. |
| Digest | One line, for example `ComfyUI: rev 14 · "deepseek-chan-emoji" · 9"},{"id":"p23s9","text":" nodes · 9 links · selected 7 · panel open.` The name appears only when the graph has one. More than"},{"id":"p23s10","text":" one open tab adds the count and the active tab. Zoom, pan, and resize do not advance `rev`. |
| Nam"},{"id":"p23s11","text":"e | Saving or loading a named workflow names the session, and the digest line includes that name. Wh"},{"id":"p23s12","text":"en `<name>.json` exists in ComfyUI's user data, the editor tab is renamed to match. |
| Storage | Do"},{"id":"p23s13","text":"main `dsh_comfyui`. A Host restart keeps the graph. The record is `sessionId -> { workflow, prompt, "},{"id":"p23s14","text":"semantic, revision, name, nameSource }` for the 20 most recently updated sessions. `nameSource` is `"},{"id":"p23s15","text":"file` or `tool`. The model sees the projection and its own edit results. A storage failure stays in "},{"id":"p23s16","text":"memory and does not block the bridge. Named workflows live in the `workflows` table. |
| Process | *"},{"id":"p23s17","text":"*Server** starts, stops, and restarts ComfyUI. The command comes from the checkout (`.venv/bin/pytho"},{"id":"p23s18","text":"n` on Unix, `.venv/Scripts/python.exe` on Windows, otherwise `python3` or `python`) and the upstream"},{"id":"p23s19","text":" port. It is not an arbitrary command. The directory and **Start with DSH** are stored in `dsh_comfy"},{"id":"p23s20","text":"ui`, not in the DSH profile. |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Model tools"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Tool | Does | Panel |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- A ComfyUI whose frontend is the standard `comfyui-frontend-package` build (relative `./assets/...`"},{"id":"p28s2","text":", `api_base` derived from the path). The panel was last verified against frontend 1.57.1. Another re"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ported version shows a notice and still loads. A server that omits the version is left alone.
- The "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"panel uses `window.comfyAPI.app.app`, a legacy shim, not a stable API. What it actually touches, and"},{"id":"p28s5","text":" how to re-check it after an upgrade, is in docs/comfyui-bridge.md.
- The DSH Web profile has `stora"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"ge`, `storage-json`, and `storage-domain` mounted. The default profile does. Without them, workflows"},{"id":"p28s7","text":" stay in memory.
- Adopting an already-running ComfyUI, so Stop and Restart still work after a reloa"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"d, needs Linux `/proc` or `lsof`. Without either, that server stays external. Starting one from the "},{"id":"p28s9","text":"panel needs neither. Adoption is retried when the panel or `comfyui_status` sees a healthy upstream."},{"id":"p28s10","text":" A listener whose working directory is not the configured checkout stays external, with its pid repo"},{"id":"p28s11","text":"rted and Stop/Restart unavailable. Windows can start a checkout from the panel. An already-running s"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"erver there stays external."}],"truncated":true}
